title: Streamline manifest signoff and publish perf-bundle for newly onboarded models
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: deliver an automated, auditable pipeline that attaches a signed 'perf_bundle' to every newly ingested model manifest, creates a pin entry, and publishes human-readable docs so product teams can safely depend on shipped profiles. Scope: schema change (add perf_bundle metadata + provenance fields), a CI gating job that runs microbenchmarks on a small perf cluster, a signoff checklist (perf regressions, SLO smoke-tests, docs snapshot), and automation to publish the performance profile bundle into the catalog and update the Console docs page. Deliverables: 1) manifest schema v2 with 'perf_bundle' and 'signature' fields, 2) new ingest pipeline step (ingest-perf) that runs bench job and records baseline, 3) pin generator that computes stable pin hash and creates draft pin in the catalog, 4) docs generator that creates/updates Confluence pages and Console catalog entry with links to benchmarks and PRs. Non-goals: full-scale benchmarking for every model variant (we'll sample). Risks: infra quota on perf cluster, flaky microbenchmarks causing false regressions, and cross-team alignment for signing keys. Links: design doc https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CATALOG/Perf+Bundle+Design , prototype PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/2846 , perf job dashboard https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/bench/perf-onboard-58907
